content.title: The Hollow Vigil
content.theme: A moorland keep where the last warden keeps a vow the dead refuse to release.
content.premise: Barrowmere Keep has held its vigil for two hundred years — long after anyone remembered what it guarded against. Now the old garrison has risen hollow from the barrow-earth, and Warden Maren, last of her order, is too old to put them down. Someone must quiet the halls, take back the barrow key, unbar the deep gate, put down the First Warden — still standing his post, long past death — and speak the vigil's ending at the barrow altar.
